title: Meta enters coding wars with Muse, taking on Claude and Codex
excerpt: Meta launched Muse Code, which aims to be a comparable coding agent that's priced lower than competitors like Anthropic's Claude or OpenAI's Codex.
content_html:
Meta is entering the coding wars with a new agent aimed at taking on Anthropic and OpenAI.

The company announced Wednesday a beta version of Muse Code — powered by its Muse Spark 1.2 AI model — that Meta said can handle complex software engineering tasks, such as writing code and validating results.

Muse Code is Meta's answer to tools like Anthropic's Claude Code and OpenAI's Codex, which have become increasingly popular among developers.

Meta's AI chief Alexandr Wang said in an X post that Muse Code is "one of the most affordable coding agents on the market, available globally."

The standard version of Muse Spark 1.2 costs $1.25 per million input tokens, 15 cents per million cached-input tokens, and $4.25 per million output tokens. Tokens are small pieces of text or code that AI models process.

A heavily discounted "contributor" tier comes with a stipulation that user activity will be used to improve Meta's products. That could appeal to individual developers and startups, while companies working with proprietary code may prefer the standard tier.

Direct comparisons can be difficult since Claude Code and Codex are bundled into subscriptions. Anthropic's Pro Plan, which is $20 a month, includes Claude Code, while Max plans cost $100 to $200 a month. OpenAI's Codex is available through a ChatGPT Plus plan that costs $20 a month. OpenAI's Pro plan costs $100 a month.

The launch reflects how software coding has become a critical part of the AI battleground. Unlike a standard chatbot, a coding agent can examine a company's software, run tests, and write code with limited supervision.

Anthropic gained early traction with Claude Code, while OpenAI expanded Codex across ChatGPT and developer terminals.

During Meta's first-quarter earnings call in April, CEO Mark Zuckerberg said that developer tools weren't the company's primary focus, though he added that he was not opposed to offering coding tools.

With Muse Code, Meta seems to be hoping to attract the same programmers who might use Claude or Codex by offering a comparable agent at a lower price.

content_html_zh:
Meta 正在通过一款旨在对抗 Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的新代理进入编码大战。

该公司周三宣布推出 Muse Code 测试版，由 Muse Spark 1.2 AI 模型提供支持，Meta 表示该版本可以处理复杂的软件工程任务，例如编写代码和验证结果。

Muse Code 是 Meta 对 Anthropic 的 Claude Code 和 OpenAI 的 Codex 等工具的回应，这些工具在开发人员中越来越受欢迎。

Meta 的 AI 主管 Alexandr Wang 在 X 帖子中表示，Muse Code 是“市场上最实惠的编码代理之一，在全球范围内都有售。”

Muse Spark 1.2 标准版的成本为每百万个输入代币 1.25 美元，每百万个缓存输入代币 15 美分，每百万个输出代币 4.25 美元。 令牌是人工智能模型处理的小段文本或代码。

大幅折扣的“贡献者”级别有一项规定，即用户活动将用于改进 Meta 的产品。 这可能会吸引个人开发人员和初创公司，而使用专有代码的公司可能更喜欢标准层。

由于 Claude Code 和 Codex 捆绑在订阅中，因此直接比较可能很困难。 Anthropic 的 Pro Plan 每月 20 美元，包括 Claude Code，而 Max 计划每月 100 至 200 美元。 OpenAI 的 Codex 可通过 ChatGPT Plus 计划获得，每月费用为 20 美元。 OpenAI 的 Pro 计划每月费用为 100 美元。

此次发布反映出软件编码如何成为人工智能战场的重要组成部分。 与标准聊天机器人不同，编码代理可以检查公司的软件、运行测试并在有限的监督下编写代码。

Anthropic 凭借 Claude Code 获得了早期关注，而 OpenAI 在 ChatGPT 和开发者终端上扩展了 Codex。

在四月份 Meta 的第一季度财报电话会议上，首席执行官马克·扎克伯格表示，开发人员工具不是公司的主要关注点，不过他补充说，他并不反对提供编码工具。

通过 Muse Code，Meta 似乎希望通过以更低的价格提供类似的代理来吸引可能使用 Claude 或 Codex 的程序员。
